WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT AN AI-NATIVE COMPANY
articles.summary: AI-native company Lovable operates with a flat structure, minimizing traditional titles and meetings, while fostering high autonomy and rapid adaptation. AI agents, paired with human "agent parents," support daily operations, highlighting the shift towards leveraging AI in company operations.

articles.title: INTRODUCING FAST SEARCH IN THE PERPLEXITY SEARCH API
articles.summary: Fast Search runs on a Rust-based retrieval and ranking service called Photon that Perplexity built with a small team of engineers and hundreds of agents. It returns 95% of search results in 230 milliseconds or less. Fast Search has a median latency of 160 milliseconds, and it spends less on compute on ranking than Perplexity's default preset. Photon now handles all of the retrieval and ranking across Perplexity, replacing the open-source engine the company was using before.

articles.title: WHY VENTURE DUE DILIGENCE GOT WORSE FOR DEEP TECH
articles.summary: Venture due diligence for deep tech has worsened, driven by deployment pressure, herding behavior, reliance on lead investors' reputations, and the removal of independent expert review layers. Deals in frontier tech sectors like AI and quantum often close rapidly without thorough technical vetting, exposing investors to unverified risks. Limited partners are advised to mandate independent technical feasibility reviews before deep-tech investments to enhance diligence and protect their capital.

articles.title: WHAT IT TAKES TO BUILD GREAT PRODUCTS NOW
articles.summary: Getting there fast doesn't mean you've built something great.
